evidence.dominant_driver: French services PMI jumped to 51.4 versus 48.3 consensus and 48.0 prior, returning services to expansion; manufacturing slipped to 50.3 versus 50.9 consensus and 51.1 prior, while the S&P report said overall activity expanded at the fastest pace in over two years and price pressures were the strongest since May.

market_expectations.source: Forex Factory calendar immediately after release
market_expectations.distribution_notes: Services delivered a very large positive surprise; manufacturing was a modest negative surprise. German and euro-area PMIs were still pending at decision time.

absorption.reason: The decision is about 16 minutes after the 07:15 UTC release; CAC 40 was already around +0.20% and Euro Stoxx 50 around +0.10%, so part of the positive growth surprise had time to enter prices.

observations.US_yields_VIX: latest reliable values are prior-US-close and too stale for fresh confirmation
observations.local_rates: no sufficiently fresh pre-decision French/Bund snapshot available

evidence.decision_notes: Residual forecast from 07:31 UTC. learning_profile.json is empty, so no learning adjustment. German/euro-area PMIs were still pending, which materially reduces 1h/4h confidence.

regimes.european_equities: quiet/slightly positive before the full PMI wave
regimes.rates: US rate snapshots stale; French/European rate reaction not sufficiently fresh
regimes.event_sequence: German and euro-area PMIs still pending, limiting persistence confidence

immediate.rationale: Services at 51.4 versus 48.3 consensus is a large positive surprise, but manufacturing missed and the CAC had already edged higher.

next_session.rationale: If the broader euro-area PMI wave confirms growth, the French services rebound should remain supportive.

15m.rationale: Services at 51.4 versus 48.3 consensus is a large positive surprise, but manufacturing missed and the CAC had already edged higher.

1h.rationale: The service-led return to growth supports domestic earnings expectations, though higher price pressures and upcoming German/eurozone PMIs cap conviction.

4h.rationale: Later German/euro-area PMI and ECB-rate repricing can dominate the French signal; manufacturing remains softer.

next_session.rationale: If the broader euro-area PMI wave confirms growth, the French services rebound should remain supportive.

predictions.mechanism: A sharp services upside surprise improves the near-term French growth/earnings signal; softer oil is supportive, while hotter prices may raise rate sensitivity.
predictions.invalidation: German/euro-area PMIs disappoint sharply, French yields jump on inflation concerns, or CAC rejects the post-release rise.
predictions.counter_case: The manufacturing miss, falling employment and stronger price pressures can turn the report stagflationary and trigger ECB-rate concerns rather than an equity rally.

technical_state.session_location: European morning, modestly above prior close

15m.rationale: France's services beat is positive for regional growth, but France is only one component of the euro area.

1h.rationale: German and euro-area releases are imminent and can override the French surprise.

4h.rationale: Regional rates and the complete PMI mix matter more than France alone.

next_session.rationale: A broader confirmation of resilient services would support euro-area equities.

predictions.invalidation: German/euro-area PMIs offset the French beat or European rates reprice sharply higher.
